tools.name: search_conferences
tools.description: Search academic conferences. Every parameter is optional — combine any of keyword, CCF/CORE/QUALIS rank, research field and submission/conference date ranges. Filter-only queries work fine (e.g. field=ai plus a submission-deadline window, no keyword). Returns a paginated list.

tools.name: search_journals
tools.description: Search academic journals. Every parameter is optional — combine any of keyword, CCF rank, research field and ISSN. Returns a paginated list.

tools.name: list_conferences
tools.description: Browse conference lists and rankings (open CFPs, ranked venues with a call open now, popularity, most competitive, etc.), paginated. No keyword filtering — use search_conferences for that.

tools.name: list_journals
tools.description: Browse journal lists and rankings (special-issue CFPs, CCF, highest impact factor, popularity, all), paginated. No keyword filtering — use search_journals for that.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_journals, get_conference, get_journal, get_researcher · Private data: get_conference, get_journal, get_researcher · Public sink: get_conference, get_journal, get_researcher.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_journals, get_conference, get_journal, get_researcher · Private data: get_conference, get_journal, get_researcher · Public sink: get_conference, get_journal, get_researcher

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
